an4.179:1.1: athakho āyasmā ānando yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi
an4.179:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca
an4.179:1.3: ko nu kho āvuso sāriputta hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme na parinibbāyantīti.
an4.179:2.1: idhāvuso ānanda sattā imā hānabhāgiyā saññāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti imā ṭhitibhāgiyā saññāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti imā visesabhāgiyā saññāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti imā nibbedhabhāgiyā saññāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti
an4.179:2.2: ayaṃ kho āvuso ānanda hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme na parinibbāyantīti.
an4.179:3.1: ko panāvuso sāriputta hetu ko paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantīti.
an4.179:3.2: idhāvuso ānanda sattā imā hānabhāgiyā saññāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti imā ṭhitibhāgiyā saññāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti imā visesabhāgiyā saññāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti imā nibbedhabhāgiyā saññāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti
an4.179:3.3: ayaṃ kho āvuso ānanda hetu ayaṃ paccayo yena midhekacce sattā diṭṭheva dhamme parinibbāyantīti.
